provision.title: Add an Android TV
provision.intro: Install and pair the VDS app on an Android TV from this page. No code to type on the TV.
provision.admin_only: The wizard is reserved for administrators.

tutorial.intro: Do this on the TV before continuing. It takes a few minutes.

2.title: Turn on network debugging
2.body: In developer options, turn on "USB debugging" then "Network debugging" (port 5555), not wireless debugging.

3.title: Google account
3.body: For a full lock (Device Owner), first remove every account and profile from the TV, then add them back after the installation. Without this, the wizard installs a soft kiosk.

4.title: Note the IP address
4.body: Find the TV's IP address (Settings > Network); reserve it in the router.

5.title: Accept the prompt
5.body: During the installation, accept the debugging prompt on the TV and tick "Always allow".

address.label: TV IP address
address.help: Local network address, for example 192.168.1.50. Public addresses are refused.

provision.soft_kiosk: Fall back to the soft kiosk if the full lock is impossible

unavailable.apk_unavailable: The Android app is not available on this server.
unavailable.server_unconfigured: The server is not set up for the wizard (secret key or public address missing).
unavailable.unknown: The wizard is not available for this site.

provision.waiting_user: Accept the prompt on the TV and tick "Always allow".
provision.waiting_online: App installed. Waiting for the screen to be "Online".
provision.done: The screen is online: the installation is validated.

kiosk.soft: Soft kiosk: the TV's Home and Assistant keys are not blocked. Reserve it for non-public screens.
kiosk.none: No lock: the app is not protected. Do not use it on a public screen.

codes.unreachable: TV unreachable: turn on network debugging on the TV and check the IP address.
codes.tls_required: This TV only accepts encrypted wireless debugging. Turn on the classic "Network debugging" (port 5555) in developer options, then try again.
codes.accept_on_tv: RSA prompt on the TV: accept it and tick "Always allow".
codes.unauthorized: Authorization refused or expired: try again and choose "Always allow" on the TV.
codes.protocol: Unexpected reply from the TV. Try again.
codes.sdk_too_old: Android is too old (7.0 or later required).
codes.apk_unavailable: The app is not available on the server.
codes.apk_mismatch: App file is corrupted: try again.
codes.already_installed: App already up to date on the TV.
codes.install_incompatible: A version signed differently is already installed: uninstall the app from the TV, then try again.
codes.owner_exists: Another device manager already exists on the TV.
codes.accounts_present: Accounts (Google) are present on the TV. For a full lock, remove accounts and profiles, retry from this step, then add them back afterwards. Otherwise, continue with the soft kiosk.
codes.extra_users: Several profiles are present: remove them to enable the full lock, or continue with the soft kiosk.
codes.dpm_refused: The TV refuses the full lock (a factory reset may be needed). Continue with the soft kiosk.
codes.no_kiosk: No lock: the app is not protected.
codes.inject_failed: Could not hand the pairing over to the TV. Use the manual pairing code.
codes.launch_failed: Could not start the app on the TV.
codes.no_provider: The site agent has no installation module for Android.
codes.ticket_expired: Pairing expired before the TV connected. Start the installation again.
codes.online_timeout: The TV did not connect to the server in time. Check its network, then start again.
codes.timeout: The installation took too long. Try again.
codes.unknown: The installation failed. Try again or use the manual pairing code.
